Match leaf water potential campaigns to the SFW table

Source: R/sfw.R
dm_match_lwp.Rd

Two-tier matching of leaf water potential (LWP) observations to SFW rows: Tier A matches on timestamp against hourly L2 data within TIER_A_TOL_MIN minutes; Tier B falls back to a date join on (series, day). match_lwp_to_sfw() is the original DendroMatic name, kept as an exported alias.

Usage

match_lwp_to_sfw(
  SFW,
  LWP_daily,
  L2_hourly = NULL,
  TIER_A_TOL_MIN = 30L,
  old_series_col = NULL,
  site_tag = "?"
)

dm_match_lwp(
  SFW,
  LWP_daily,
  L2_hourly = NULL,
  TIER_A_TOL_MIN = 30L,
  old_series_col = NULL,
  site_tag = "?"
)

Arguments

SFW

SFW data.frame; must contain series, day, MDS_max, pdtwd, mdtwd.

LWP_daily

LWP data.frame; must contain series, day, pdlwp, mdlwp.

L2_hourly

Optional hourly L2 data.frame enabling Tier A timestamp matching.

TIER_A_TOL_MIN

Tier A matching tolerance in minutes.

old_series_col

Optional column in LWP_daily holding legacy series names to translate.

site_tag

Site label used in diagnostic messages.

Value

The SFW data.frame with matched LWP columns and per-row tier flags (lwp_tier_pd, lwp_tier_md).
